name: Utuchekulu
body:
UTUCHEKULU
CR 2

This diminutive humanoid has jet-black skin, wild and unkempt hair, red eyes, and a single long fang that hangs from its upper jaw.

XP 600
LE Small humanoid
Init +7; Senses darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 size)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 25 ft.
Melee bite +6 (1d4+4/19–20), spear +6 (1d6+4/x3)
Ranged shortbow +6 (1d4/x3)
Special Attacks sneak attack +2d6 (bite only), trip (bite or trip)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 9, Wis 13, Cha 11
Base Atk +2; CMB +4; CMD 17
Feats Athletic, Improved Initiative
Skills Climb +9, Stealth +9, Swim +5
Languages Common
Special Qualities Treeborne

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Treeborne (Ex)

Utuchekulu get +2 on Climb and Stealth checks in forest or jungle terrain.

ECOLOGY

Environment any wooded area
Organization solitary, swarm (2-4), or village (10+)
Treasure none

Utuchekulu (akachekulu when singular) are reclusive beings who live in hollowed out trees, generally keeping away from other creatures. They are about 3 feet tall and stocky in stature, resembling dwarves with dark brown or black skin and thinner hair. They also have blood red teeth with one growing particularly long and sharp; this especially sharp tooth allows a small group of utuchekulu to ambush and kill larger beings with ease, with their favorite tactic dropping from the trees in which they reside onto their unfortunate victims.

Although usually they hunt other humanoids for sport and sustenance, they have been known to offer deals to assist those in dangerous situations. They will ask for goods or services and offer nothing in return up front, but for those who decide to assist them, they provide some form of assistance out of their current situation.

Typically found living alone or in small groups in hollowed out trees, utuchekulu particularly favor ambush tactics and will swarm and pounce over larger beings to overwhelm them quickly while biting them to death with their pronounced tooth. They will use other weapons as necessary but particularly relish a kill with their bite attacks.
